title: TFC-Zoological
description: A Vanilla revamp of the TerraFirmaCraft (TFC) Mobs using Entity Model Features (EMF)
body:
I think TerraFirmaCraft is a genuinely really cool mod, but I also feel like the models and textures are a bit outdated. In particular, the mobs.

This pack aims to adjust that, with revamped models and textures for the many mobs of TFC in order to make them look more Vanilla, and more like the animal they are meant to be at the same time.
The Resource pack REQUIRES the use of Entity Model Features, and will not work properly without it.

I HAVE NO AFFILIATION WITH ANY DEVELOPER OF TFC, I AM SIMPLY A FAN WITH TIME ON HER HANDS

If you notice any issues with the resource pack, feel free to DM me at my [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/thegayestvivian.bsky.social)
